basic_info.description: Sun-drenched, elegant condominium located just steps from the Panhandle and Golden Gate Park! Original Victorian details throughout include hardwood flooring, soaring ceilings, moldings, and oversized bay windows. The floorplan is perfect for entertaining, with a seamless flow between the formal living room with a fireplace and curved window bay, home office area, and dining area, all overlooking the picturesque, tree-lined Slow Street' below. The open kitchen has been beautifully remodeled with deluxe stainless appliances, quartz countertops, and a breakfast bar for informal dining. Attached to the kitchen is a fabulous home office doubling as laundry with built-in desk, custom cabinetry, and a stacked washer/dryer. 2 serene and lovely bedrooms at the rear of the home share a renovated bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower over tub. One of the bedrooms opens via sliding glass doors to a spacious and sunny private deck, a fantastic spot for relaxation and entertaining. This unit enjoys a private entrance, as well as internal access to a private, 2-car garage and a storage room. Conveniently located at the intersection of the Haight, NOPA and Cole Valley, with great restaurants, easy access to public transit, and 3 parks: the Panhandle, Golden Gate Park and Buena Vista Park.
